demos.title: Scope usage
demos.description: GET /video/api/v1/scopes/{scope_key}/usage/ — who inside one partition talked how much, per calendar month. Three states, and the point of the pair is that none of them collapses into another: rows, a month that succeeded and holds nobody, and the uniform error.404.video_scope_not_found that covers a missing scope, a scope with no calls and a reader holding no USAGE_MANDATE all at once (a 403 would confirm that a guessed tenant id is real). The wire carries user ids and never names; the host resolves them through nameFor.
